title: wsl-notice config
description: .config/wsl-notice/config.yaml under the home directory from the password database (HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME are not read; --config selects another file) plus config.d/*.yaml beside it in lexical order; maps merge. Strict YAML loader. Invalid config exits 2 (config_invalid), naming the key. Precedence: flags, then config, then defaults; there are no environment overrides.

powershell_bin.description: Absolute path of Windows PowerShell 5.1. No PATH search, no drive letters, no backslashes.

app_id.description: Application identity the toast is shown under. The default is the Windows PowerShell identity, which needs no registration. An unregistered identity gives no error and may show nothing.

level_prefix.description: Title prefix per level, one line of at most 16 characters. Maps merge across drop-ins. Values are run through the title rule (sanitizer steps 1 to 5) and must come out unchanged, else config_invalid.

timeout.description: One monotonic deadline for a send, 5s to 60s (enforced by the tool).

link_hosts.description: Optional, unset by default. Host names in lowercase of at least two labels joined by single dots; an entry that does not match is config_invalid. When set, a link's host (lowercased, no port; a bracket host never matches) must equal an entry or end with '.' plus an entry, else exit 20 link_invalid.

duration.description: A number of seconds, or a string matching [0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(ms|s|m)? (no unit means seconds; no h or d). The range of each key is in the key's description and is enforced by the tool (false for NaN).
